svg.text: 1 · The 80 observation features, by how opponent behaviour can reach them
tile = one feature (index); colour = opponent channel from obsSpec.js — hover for the name and definition

g.title: 0 phase_reauction — 1 in the re-auction, 0 in the main round [none, current]
1 main_progress — share of the main-round pool already auctioned (1 in re-auction) [none, current]
2 lots_left_in_phase — players still to come in this phase / main-pool size [none, current]
3 returning_count — players unsold so far (back in the re-auction) / main-pool size [supply, cumulative]
4 set_index — lot set number / 10 [none, current]
5 purse_scale — log2(room purse / 12500) / 2 (room purse stratum) [none, current]
6 lot_is_batsman — lot role = batsman [none, current]
7 lot_is_bowler — lot role = bowler [none, current]
8 lot_is_all_rounder — lot role = all-rounder [none, current]
9 lot_is_keeper — lot role = wicket keeper [none, current]
10 lot_is_overseas — lot is an overseas player [none, current]
11 lot_rating — (rating − 60) / 40 [none, current]
12 lot_is_star — rating ≥ 90 [none, current]
13 lot_base_price — base price / slot budget (purse / 25) [none, current]
14 lot_fair_value — fair value / slot budget [none, current]
15 self_purse — own purse left / room purse [own, current]
16 self_slots_left — own squad slots left / 25 [own, current]
17 self_overseas_slots_left — own overseas slots left / 8 [own, current]
18 self_class_Wi — own Indian keepers / 11 [own, current]
19 self_class_Wo — own overseas keepers / 11 [own, current]
20 self_class_Bi — own Indian bowling options / 11 [own, current]
21 self_class_Bo — own overseas bowling options / 11 [own, current]
22 self_class_Oi — own other Indian players / 11 [own, current]
23 self_class_Oo — own other overseas players / 11 [own, current]
24 self_xi_strength — own best-XI total / 1100 [own, current]
25 self_xi_empty — own empty XI slots / 11 [own, current]
26 self_xi_floor — (weakest own XI rating − 60) / 40; 0 while the XI has empty slots [own, current]
27 self_xi_overseas — overseas players in own best XI / 4 [own, current]
28 self_status_keeper — planner keeper status (SAFE 0 = need met, NEED 1/3, CRITICAL 2/3, IMPOSSIBLE 1); CRITICAL uses rivals needing a keeper [direct, current]
29 self_status_bowling — planner bowling status (as above) [direct, current]
30 self_status_indians — planner Indians status (as above) [direct, current]
31 self_status_players — planner squad-count status (as above) [direct, current]
32 self_need_keeper — keepers still needed / 1 [own, current]
33 self_need_bowling — bowling options still needed / 5 [own, current]
34 self_need_indians — Indians still needed / 11 [own, current]
35 self_need_players — XI players still needed / 11 [own, current]
36 self_reserve_if_passed — cheapest legal completion (at base prices of remaining supply) if this lot is passed / purse; 1 if unreachable [own, current]
37 self_max_safe_purse — maxSafeBid / room purse [own, current]
38 self_max_safe_fv — maxSafeBid / fair value [own, current]
39 self_xi_gain_share — own XI gain from this lot / (rating / 11) [own, current]
40 self_xi_gain — own XI gain from this lot / 10 [own, current]
41 self_fills_keeper — lot fills an unmet own keeper requirement [own, current]
42 self_fills_bowling — lot fills an unmet own bowling requirement [own, current]
43 self_fills_indians — lot fills an unmet own Indians requirement [own, current]
44 self_unlocks — buying reaches a better XI than passing [own, current]
45 self_final_opportunity — planner final-opportunity flag (after this lot fewer suitable players remain than needed, or unlocks) [own, current]
46 self_pace_gap — share of own purse spent − share of premium value already auctioned [own, cumulative]
47 self_upgrades_left — players still to come rated above the own XI floor / 50 [supply, current]
48 self_typical_upgrade — mean XI gain of those upgrades / 2 (0 while XI incomplete) [supply, current]
49 self_bench — (squad − XI players) / 14 [own, current]
50 mkt_equivalent_left — same role within 3 rating points still to come / 10 [supply, current]
51 mkt_better_left — same role, higher rating still to come / 10 [supply, current]
52 mkt_same_role_left — same role still to come / 40 [supply, current]
53 mkt_supply_Wi — Indian keepers still to come (incl. returning) / 40 [supply, current]
54 mkt_supply_Wo — overseas keepers still to come (incl. returning) / 40 [supply, current]
55 mkt_supply_Bi — Indian bowling options still to come / 40 [supply, current]
56 mkt_supply_Bo — overseas bowling options still to come / 40 [supply, current]
57 mkt_supply_Oi — other Indians still to come / 40 [supply, current]
58 mkt_supply_Oo — other overseas still to come / 40 [supply, current]
59 mkt_scarcity_keeper — keepers affordable to self after this lot / (own need + rivals NEEDING a keeper + 1) [direct, current]
60 mkt_scarcity_bowling — bowling options after this lot / (own need + rivals needing + 1) [direct, current]
61 mkt_scarcity_indians — Indians after this lot / (own need + rivals needing + 1) [direct, current]
62 mkt_overseas_contested — overseas lot and more better overseas players still to come than own overseas slots after buying [own, current]
63 mkt_premium_passed — share of premium value (fair − base) already auctioned [none, cumulative]
64 mkt_recent_price_ratio — mean price / fair value of SALES in the last 20 lots (1 if none) — any buyer incl. self [direct, window20]
65 mkt_recent_sold_share — share of the last 20 lots that sold (1 if none) [direct, window20]
66 riv_purse_max — max rival purse / room purse [direct, current]
67 riv_purse_mean — mean rival purse / room purse [direct, current]
68 riv_purse_min — min rival purse / room purse [direct, current]
69 riv_purse_std — std of rival purse / room purse [direct, current]
70 riv_capacity_1 — highest rival (purse − own-completion cost) / fair value, rivals able to bid [direct, current]
71 riv_capacity_2 — 2nd-highest rival capacity (as above) [direct, current]
72 riv_capacity_3 — 3rd-highest rival capacity (as above) [direct, current]
73 riv_able_share — share of rivals whose capacity ≥ fair value [direct, current]
74 riv_fills_share — share of rivals for whom the lot fills ANY unmet requirement (keeper/bowling/indians/players pooled) [direct, current]
75 riv_gain_mean — mean rival XI gain from the lot / (rating / 11); 0 for rivals who cannot bid [direct, current]
76 riv_free_slots_share — share of rivals with squad slots left [direct, current]
77 riv_recent_spend — rival spend in the last 20 lots / (rivals × purse) × (pool / window) — pooled over all rivals [direct, window20]
78 riv_xi_mean — mean rival best-XI total / 1100 [direct, current]
79 riv_xi_max — max rival best-XI total / 1100 [direct, current]
